entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: By this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the petitioner has prayed for setting aside and quashing of the order dated 28.05.2024 passed by the learned SDJM(S), Kokrajhar in Bagribari PS Case No. 42/2024 under Section 376 IPC, whereby the learned court passed an order allowing the prayer of the IO of the case to take blood samples of the accused/petitioner, the victim girl and the child and to examine the same by constituting Medical Board for DNA test.
As Mr. R. J. Baruah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has entered appearance on behalf of the State respondent No.1, no formal notice need to be issued.
However, a copy of the petition along with the documents annexed thereto be furnished to him.
Issue notice to the respondent No.2 by registered A/D post and usual process, returnable within 4(four) weeks.
Steps be taken within seven days.

Learned counsel for the petitioner prays to stay the impugned order dated 28.05.2024 by showing the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Ashok Kumar(S) v. Raj Gupta and others(s) reported in 2022 SCC 1 20 wherein it has been stated that the order for DNA test should not be passed in a routine manner.

entities.text: Ashok Kumar(S) v. Raj Gupta and others(s) reported in 2022 SCC 1 20
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor has raised objection to the prayer of the petitioner for stay.

Considering the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, further proceeding of the order dated 28.05.2024 passed by the learned SDJM(S), Kokrajhar in Bagribari PS Case No. 42/2024 shall remain stayed, till the returnable date.
Call for the scanned copy of the case diary.
List the matter accordingly after 4(four) weeks.
